Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick intro this morning. To get the contract review moving on our side, could you confirm the following so our legal team can assemble the first pass of redlines?

- Full legal entity name, address, and billing contact (name/email/phone)
- Counterparty signing authority (name and title)
- Any specific procurement terms you need (PO requirement, invoice cadence, tax details)
- Do you have a preferred MSA template or do you want us to start from our Redwood MSA (attached)?

Goal: we’d like to circulate an initial redline within 3 business days of receiving the details above. If Corelytics prefers to provide a redline to our MSA instead, we can accept that but please send it as a tracked Word file.

I attached our standard MSA v3 and example order form so you can see exhibits we normally include.

Thanks —
